clue.text: Where a non-starter is left beside the pillar-box

definitions.meaning: in horse racing a runner that never leaves the starting gate is said to be left there
standing next to the postbox, the red street box for mail in Britain

explanation.surface: A runner who never set off is found loitering next to a red postbox.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing idiom for a horse that fails to start, and literally standing next to a mailbox.

clue.text: Keynote to vigorous health

definitions.meaning: in music the keynote is the first note of the scale
a restorative medicine promotes strength and wellbeing

explanation.surface: The key message of a talk is the route to robust fitness.
explanation.definitionFit: In music the first degree of a scale has this name; a bracing restorative drink or medicine shares it.

clue.text: What the vertiginous brickie takes before calling for a stretcher?

definitions.text: What the vertiginous brickie takes before calling for a stretcher?

parts.words: What the vertiginous brickie takes before calling for a stretcher
parts.note: a dizzy bricklayer falls head first off the scaffold, and needs a stretcher; a stretcher is also a brick laid lengthways

explanation.surface: A dizzy bricklayer topples off the scaffold and is carried away.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'stretcher' is also a brick laid lengthwise, so the brickie might seem to be asking for building material.
explanation.definitionFit: A headlong fall is a plunge taken head first.

clue.text: No port is manufactured without delay

indicators.note: something manufactured is made up anew, so these letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A factory claims it produces no fortified wine, and quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal synonym: immediately, at once.

clue.text: Take notice, but not of that "early to bed" advice

definitions.meaning: to become suddenly alert and attentive

definitions.text: not of that "early to bed" advice
definitions.meaning: to stay awake late into the night, ignoring the proverb about retiring early

explanation.surface: Pay attention, but don't follow the old saw about going to bed early.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to become alert and to stay out of bed late.

clue.text: Outstanding title for his imperial majesty

definitions.meaning: superlative of very good
a formal honorific used for some rulers and orders of chivalry

explanation.surface: A grand honorific suitable for an emperor.
explanation.definitionFit: A superlative meaning superb, and also a formal style of address for exalted persons.

clue.text: Rallying cry to city investors up against it

definitions.meaning: read as 'support Wall Street', a call to financiers to put money behind the market
in a desperate position with no retreat

explanation.surface: A slogan urging financiers on when times are hard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Back' means put money on, and 'the Wall' suggests Wall Street, the New York financial district.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for being cornered, and literally an urging to support the stock market.

clue.text: Circumlocutory description of a ring-road?

parts.note: a phrase for an indirect manner, also read literally as a road around a traffic circle

explanation.surface: A long-winded way of describing a road that circles a town.
explanation.definitionFit: An indirect manner of speaking or travelling; a ring-road literally goes around.

clue.text: It heralds doom for the whist player with no good suit

definitions.meaning: the trumpet blast announcing Judgement Day

definitions.text: for the whist player with no good suit
definitions.meaning: a card player short of strong cards is left with only a final trump card

explanation.surface: A card player with a poor hand sees disaster coming.
explanation.definitionFit: Biblical image of the final trumpet call, and literally a card player's final trump.

clue.text: Kept fresh like food already dished up

definitions.meaning: conserved, as in jam or pickles
served beforehand

explanation.surface: Food that has been dished up early has been kept fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: Conserved against decay, and read as a prefix plus verb, served in advance.

clue.text: Athenian garret

definitions.meaning: relating to Athens or its dialect of Greek
a room in the roof space

explanation.surface: A loft room in Athens.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjective for classical Athens, and a room under the roof of a house.

clue.text: A game fire-raiser

definitions.meaning: a card game of bluffing and betting
the iron rod used to stir up a fire and make it blaze

explanation.surface: A plucky arsonist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Game' looks like an adjective (willing), and 'fire-raiser' like an arsonist.
explanation.definitionFit: A card game of betting and bluff, and the fireside iron that stirs coals into flame.

clue.text: Suffer a burn

definitions.meaning: to tolerate or put up with
burn is Scottish for a small stream

explanation.surface: To endure a scald.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Burn' is a Scottish word for a stream, not an injury.
explanation.definitionFit: A verb for tolerating, and a noun for a small stream or creek.

clue.text: Mock stone needs an extra shove

parts.note: to boo is to jeer or mock
ST is the abbreviation for stone, a British weight of fourteen pounds

explanation.surface: A fake rock needs more of a push to move it.
explanation.definitionFit: A push or lift upward; synonym for an added thrust.

clue.text: Willow twigs Rosie weaves

definitions.note: the answer is the singular, used also for the plant or its pliant shoots collectively

indicators.note: weaving twists strands together, so the letters of the name are interlaced in a new order

explanation.surface: A girl called Rosie makes baskets from willow.
explanation.definitionFit: The basket willow and its flexible shoots used in wickerwork.

clue.text: Need, so one hears, to make dough

indicators.note: what one hears is a sound-alike, so the word is taken as spoken

parts.note: these words are said aloud, and what is heard is the sound this part of the answer needs

explanation.surface: A baker says one needs to work the bread mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Working and pressing a flour mixture by hand is how bread is prepared.

clue.text: A DJ presents duet about 10 followed by appeal

indicators.note: the next piece comes after the previous one
about means moved around, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral ten
O is an exclamation of appeal, as in O Lord

explanation.surface: A disc jockey plays a duet of about ten tracks, then makes a plea.
explanation.walkthrough: DJ means dinner jacket, not disc jockey. 'About' jumbles DUET with X into TUXED.
explanation.definitionFit: DJ is a British abbreviation for dinner jacket, the black-tie evening jacket.

clue.text: Big-wigs invest a shilling in the Noise Abatement Society

indicators.note: to invest is to put money into something, so one piece is placed within another
in tells us where the money is put, inside the society's letters

parts.note: NAS is its initials
bob is old British slang for a shilling coin

explanation.surface: Wealthy men put a little money into a campaign against noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Important or wealthy people; originally Indian governors.

clue.text: Compound of hydrogen removed from ox-hide

indicators.note: taking something away from a word means a letter is deleted

parts.note: H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: A chemistry note about extracting hydrogen from a cow's skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical compound of oxygen with another element.

clue.text: Royal Thracian monkey

definitions.meaning: a king of Thrace killed at Troy in the Iliad
a macaque of Asia

explanation.surface: A monkey of noble Thracian lineage.
explanation.definitionFit: A mythical Thracian king slain in Homer's epic, and the macaque used in medical research.

clue.text: A king badly hurt by Lancelot

definitions.text: A king badly hurt by Lancelot

parts.note: R is short for rex, Latin for king

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so these letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Camelot's ruler was wounded by his knight's betrayal.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes the legendary king betrayed when Lancelot loved Guinevere.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary British king whose queen and kingdom were undone by Lancelot's affair.

clue.text: The wheel is roadworthy despite being worn out

definitions.meaning: read as tyred: fitted with a tyre
exhausted, weary

explanation.surface: A wheel that is fit for the road despite being worn.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is a pun on tyre, the rubber casing of a wheel.
explanation.definitionFit: Sounding like fitted with a rubber tyre, and also exhausted or weary.

clue.text: I am friend to a South African native runner

parts.note: I'M is the contraction
pal is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone introduces themselves as a friend to a South African athlete.
explanation.definitionFit: An African antelope noted for speed and leaping.

clue.text: Aim to give listener cause to love

parts.note: an end is a goal or aim
the ear is the organ of hearing

explanation.surface: Trying to give someone reason to be fond of you.
explanation.definitionFit: To make someone fond; synonym of charm.

clue.text: Barley processed by a Mediterranean republic

parts.note: malt is barley that has been soaked and germinated for brewing

explanation.surface: Barley is processed by an island nation.
explanation.definitionFit: An island nation south of Sicily.

clue.text: Farewell to a gambling cube cast in gold

indicators.note: set in like a jewel cast in metal, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: AU is the chemical symbol for gold
a die is a gambling cube

explanation.surface: Goodbye to a dice set in gold.
explanation.definitionFit: French for goodbye, used in English too.

clue.text: Look for water to soak

definitions.meaning: to search for underground water with a divining rod
a variant spelling of douse, to drench

explanation.surface: Searching for water in order to drench something.
explanation.definitionFit: Water divining, and an accepted variant of the verb meaning drench.

clue.text: Romantic reminders of palmy days?

parts.note: outings with a sweetheart, fruit of a palm tree, and markers of the calendar all share this word

explanation.surface: Fond memories of happier times.
explanation.walkthrough: Palmy days means prosperous times, but the palm also bears fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Romantic appointments, palm fruits, and calendar days all share the word.

clue.text: What chatty columnists use to give news of fashion

parts.note: to intimate is to announce or make known
style is fashion

explanation.surface: Gossip columnists write in a familiar way about the latest trends.
explanation.definitionFit: A familiar, personal manner of writing.

clue.text: Dash from one pavement to the other and bump into someone

definitions.text: Dash from one pavement to the other
definitions.meaning: to sprint over the road
to meet by chance

explanation.surface: Sprinting over the road and colliding with a passer-by.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally sprinting over a street, and idiomatically meeting someone by chance.
